about: Every image captured from the old Wix site (fbcm-archive/images), classified, with the upload plan for the Sanity media library. upload:true rows are church photographs that scripts/upload-photo-library.mjs puts in the library with this title, altText, description and tags. Rows 1-376 were classified from contact sheets on 2026-09-22; the 77 gap-fill files on 2026-09-23 (56 are byte-identical copies of earlier files). Children: every photo of a child from the old site is approved by the church.
